responsible_ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
responsible_department: Department of Health and Family Welfare (CGHS is a Central Sector Scheme headed by Additional Secretary & Director General, CGHS)
implementing_authority: CGHS Wellness Centres / Additional Directors of CGHS in each covered city
description: India's oldest ongoing central health scheme (started 1954), providing comprehensive OPD and hospitalization care to serving/retired Central Government employees, MPs, judges, and other specified categories, in notified CGHS-covered cities.

applicable_states.note: Coverage is by NOTIFIED CITY, not by state; roughly 25-26 cities per the 2015-16 source used here, reportedly expanded since (NEEDS_VERIFICATION).

target_population: Serving/retired Central Government employees, their dependents, and specific additional categories (MPs, ex-MPs, judges, Freedom Fighters, Delhi Police, Railway Board employees, etc.) residing in a CGHS-covered city.
eligibility_factors_not_applicable: age (tied to employment/pension status, not a standalone age gate)
